title: Cosmic River Monster
description: A large green tentacled monster with glowing blue eyes sits on the riverbank in the foreground, holding a piece of paper and surrounded by cookies and pottery. Behind it, a wooden boat carries several people down a river that flows through a valley filled with crowds of spectators, leading toward a massive swirling cosmic portal with a bright sun at its center in the sky.
prompt: A large friendly green tentacled monster with glowing cyan eyes sits on a grassy riverbank holding a letter, surrounded by cookies and ornate pottery. A wooden sailboat with passengers floats on the river. Crowds of people stand on both sides of the valley watching. Dramatic swirling cosmic portal with rings of fire and a bright sun dominates the sky above, purple and orange clouds, birds flying, detailed fantasy landscape, vibrant colors.
